in_hebrew.name: חדווה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Drawn from or derived from the Hebrew root 'hadav' (חדב), which means 'to give,' 'to pour out,' 'to love,' 'to have mercy,' or 'to be gracious.' This name, Hedvah, can be interpreted as 'beloved' or 'one who pours out love.'
